PREDEFINE001.name: table2md
PREDEFINE001.description: Converts all worksheets in an Excel workbook into Markdown tables with A1 cell position notation.

args.name: file_object
args.description: An openpyxl Workbook object containing one or more worksheets to be converted.

returns.description: A dictionary mapping each worksheet title to its corresponding Markdown table string.

PREDEFINE002.name: get_metadata
PREDEFINE002.description: Extracts hierarchical metadata and structural insights from LLM-compatible Excel sheet strings using a language model.

args.name: sheet_strings
args.description: A dictionary where keys are sheet names and values are LLM-compatible strings representing Excel tables.

returns.description: A structured dictionary containing metadata for each sheet, including hierarchy, data samples, summary, and basic statistics. Returns an error message if the LLM response is invalid.
